title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
abstract: arXiv:2609.16997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phas

translated_title: 大语言模型能跟上危机的脉搏吗？评估孟加拉国七月起义中的危机情感
translated_abstract: 危机情感分析对于孟加拉语等低资源语言而言尤其具有挑战性，因为其语言、语境和公众反应变化迅速。我们推出了UNRESTSENT200K，一个孟加拉语危机情感数据集，包含约20万条来自2024年7-8月孟加拉国起义期间的Facebook和YouTube评论。该数据集涵盖了五个与事件对齐的阶段，从早期的局势升级和网络中断，到政权更迭以及随后的洪灾危机。每条评论都与其父帖文相关联，从而支持在有语境和无语境两种条件下进行评估。所有评论均通过完全人工的流程进行标注，涉及14名以孟加拉语为母语的标注员以及资深人员的审核校验，达成了较高的一致性（kappa = 0.73，alpha = 0.71）和94.2%的盲审一致率。我们对微调的编码器模型、基于提示的大语言模型以及LoRA微调的大语言模型进行了基准测试。结果显示，父帖文语境始终能够提升性能，而各阶段之间的时间性变化……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文推出了UNRESTSENT200K——一个涵盖孟加拉国七月起义五个事件阶段、约20万条人工标注孟加拉语危机评论的数据集，并通过基准测试发现父帖文语境能持续提升编码器和LLM的危机情感分析性能。
